data.content:
Here's a summary of what was implemented:

**Files created/modified:**

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `TicketClassifier.csproj` | Added `Microsoft.ML 4.0.2` + CSV copy rule |
| `Models/TicketModels.cs` | `TicketData`, `TicketPrediction`, request/response DTOs |
| `Services/TicketClassifierService.cs` | ML pipeline: text featurization → SDCA Maximum Entropy trainer |
| `Program.cs` | Minimal API endpoints + DI registration |

**Endpoints:**

- **`POST /api/tickets/classify`** — Accepts `{subject, description, priority}`, returns predicted category + per-class confidence scores
- **`GET /api/tickets/metrics`** — Returns evaluation metrics (macro/micro accuracy, log loss)

**Verified results:** Technical and Billing tickets classified correctly with >90% confidence. Validation rejects invalid priority values. The "General" category has lower accuracy due to only 6 training samples — adding more data to `tickets.csv` will improve it.
